decisions.decision: The Grappled creature's Speed is 0 and can not increase. Its attack rolls against targets other than the grappler have Disadvantage; this condition does not impose that penalty on attacks against the grappler. End the grapple if the grappler becomes Incapacitated or an effect moves the grappled creature out of the grappler's reach.
